description: This file is a PHP source code file for a web interface page that allows editing wireless network settings such as SSID, security mode, channel, and password. It includes server-side PHP logic for processing parameters and client-side JavaScript for UI interactions and form validation.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves specific extended key-value pairs from an external system or configuration root object.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for Wi-Fi security mode selection with options for changing security settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data and sends an AJAX request to save the wireless network configuration.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends a reset instruction via AJAX to restore Wi-Fi settings to default or previous state.
